correctness.rationale: The max-product Hausdorff formula and the 1-Lipschitz radius functional give exact distance preservation. Inclusion, singleton behavior, compactness, and outer-parallel-body preservation follow directly from the product construction; the coordinate shift c0⊕∞R→c0 is a surjective linear isometry. Published RESULT, REVIEW, and SLOGAN bytes match the integrity hashes recorded in METADATA.json.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 surjective rigidity paper and the Gruber–Lettl Euclidean classification do not contain the radius-dependent origin-fixing self-embedding. The closest identified non-surjective source is Zhou (2022), whose abstract was inspected but whose full text was not.

value.rationale: The construction shows that surjectivity in the arbitrary-Banach hyperspace rigidity theorem cannot be replaced by origin normalization, order embedding, or exact preservation of outer parallel bodies, and it gives a proper self-embedding already on c0 for both bounded-closed and compact-convex hyperspaces.
